text: Reading 100,000 elements by index took 1 ms from an ArrayList and 2,589 ms from a LinkedList. Why?
choices: The ArrayList was cached in memory
The array does arithmetic; the linked list follows i references to reach element i
LinkedList checks bounds and ArrayList does not
explanation: Constant time versus linear, plus poor cache locality — a linked list's nodes are scattered, so each hop may be a fresh memory fetch. The practical advice surprises people: use ArrayList almost always.
